thread:
sofia: Heads-up: nightly hetero-gpu smoke went red on h100-canary around 03:45 UTC — non-fatal kernel error + transient OOM on the same shard. Filing here before I start requeues.

sofia: CI artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/arch/38082/artifacts (core + gpu logs attached)

matt: Thanks. Do we have the job id and container image?

sofia: job=nightly-hetero/38082, image=redwood/hetero-smoke:2026-03-18-canary, driver=525.85, cuda=12.2

devon: Quick skim of the logs: I see an Xid=224 on gpu0 then a brief OOM from the warmup stage. Kernel printed: `nvrm: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU lockup — aborting command stream` (snippet below).
```
[03:45:12] nvrm: Xid 224: PZ fault on enqueue
[03:45:12] nvrm: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU lockup — aborting command stream
[03:45:13] runtime: cudaStreamSynchronize returned CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN
[03:45:14] oom: Alloc failed: requested 1.2G, free 900M
```

tara: Could be driver mismatch with our patched runtime kernels. Is this only on canary h100? Any hetero nodes green?

sofia: repro so far only on canary pool (h100-canary-3). regular nightly on h100-prod nodes passed.

lee: If it's only canary, temporary mitigation: requeue the failing shard to a different canary host or bump retry to 2 and run with smaller batch (BATCH_SIZE=1). Also check if recent infra PR touched kernel compile flags.

matt: @devon can you run a quick targeted rerun with env var RL_DEBUG_KERN=1 and BATCH_SIZE=1 on the same image? If we get the same Xid we should bisect driver or kernel changes.

devon: On it. Command I'll use: `ci rerun --job nightly-hetero/38082 --shard=3 --env BATCH_SIZE=1,RL_DEBUG_KERN=1` — starting now.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: nightly-hetero/38082#shard3 (rerun id 38082.r1). Logs will appear at https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/38082.r1

devon: First rerun finished: same Xid 224, slightly different backtrace. Looks like a kernel assert in our quant-attn CUDA module. Pasting top frames: `quant_attn.cu:__device__ compute_kv+0x3f`, then `kernel_launch:attn_forward`

matt: That points to a regression in the runtime kernels or a bad code path under patched cuDNN. Any recent PRs touching quant-attn or kernel compilation?

sofia: PRs since last green: #7245 (attn refactor), #7251 (toolkit pins), #7259 (canary tooling). @matt @tara I suspect #7245 or #7251.

tara: Ok let's bisect: devon, can you rerun the same shard against an older image that predates #7245? If older image is green -> blame #7245. If still red, try older driver (525.78).

devon: Scheduling two bisect runs: (A) image redwood/hetero-smoke:2026-03-15 (pre-#7245) and (B) same image but force driver 525.78 via node repro (requires nodemgr override). Will update links when done.

lee: Meanwhile, short-term customer impact is low since prod h100 passed. Let's gate canary on reruns: set canary routing to disable this host until we confirm root cause. I'll add a manual host quarantine.

sofia: Quarantine applied to h100-canary-3. Also increased retry to 2 for nightly until we finish bisect.

devon: Bisect run A (older image) completed: green on shard3. Run B (older driver) queued — will need nodemgr window (~10m).

matt: That's a strong signal pointing at #7245 (attn refactor). Can we reproduce locally with a small kernel debug build to get variable/state that triggers assert?

devon: I'll repro with cuda-gdb attached to node and build a debug image. If we can hit the assert locally we should get a concrete stack + kernel args.

sofia: Thanks team. Action items: devon to reproduce & attach debug, matt to review #7245 for potential bounds/stride changes, tara to hold canary routing and track driver pinning, lee to follow up on quarantine. I'll keep the thread updated with logs. :thumbsup:

matt: ping me in thread when you have the kernel backtrace. I'll take PR triage.

ci-bot: (automated) 38082.r2: run completed — green on shard3 with older image. 38082.r3: run queued (driver-525.78).

devon: Driver-525.78 run shows the same failure — so older driver didn't help. That narrows to code in #7245. I've captured a kernel assert with arg values; uploading to artifacts now.

sofia: Great work. If we confirm #7245 is the culprit we'll open an urgent fix PR and revert canary until patch lands.

lee: I'll prepare a hotfix branch template and a canary revert if needed.

sofia: Closing loop for now; will update once debug artifact link is live.

matt: thanks all.
